newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bond mart quiet, buyers await issues.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bond mart quiet, buyers await issues.

text.p: Investors continued to focus on new U.S. corporate bond deals coming to market, leaving activity in the secondary market fairly quiet on Tuesday, traders said.
Investors in high-grade paper were kept busy with two large asset-backed security deals as well as several new issues of straight corporate debt.
A syndicate official said more high-grade buyers seem willing to invest in both types of products.
"Increasingly, buyers of shorter corporates are looking at asset-backed securities to pick up yield," he added.
